1.english_reference: Zedekiah [ was ] one and twenty years old when he began to reign

traditions.KJV: Zedekiah [ was ] one and twenty years old when he began to reign ,

1.english_reference: and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וְ אַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ ירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔ וֹ חמיטל בַּֽת יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מִ לִּבְנָֽה

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ רַ֖ע בְּ עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּ כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה יְהוֹיָקִֽים

traditions.KJV: And he did [ that which was ] evil in the eyes of the LORD , according to all that Jehoiakim had done .

3.english_reference: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah , till he had cast them out from his presence

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י עַל אַ֣ף יְהוָ֗ה הָֽיְתָה֙ בִּ ירוּשָׁלִַ֣ם וִֽ יהוּדָ֔ה עַד הִשְׁלִיכ֥ וֹ אוֹתָ֖ ם מֵ עַ֣ל פָּנָ֑י
traditions.VUL: Quóniam furor Dómini erat in Ierúsalem et in Iuda , úsquequo proíceret eos a fácie sua :
traditions.KJV: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah , till he had cast them out from his presence ,

traditions.VUL: et recéssit Sedecías a rege Babylónis .
traditions.KJV: that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon .

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִי֩ בַ שָּׁנָ֨ה הַ תְּשִׁעִ֜ית לְ מָלְכ֗ וֹ בַּ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ עֲשִׂירִי֮ בֶּ עָשׂ֣וֹר לַ חֹדֶשׁ֒

traditions.KJV: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah .

6.english_reference: And in the fourth month , in the ninth [ day ] of the month

traditions.KJV: And in the fourth month , in the ninth [ day ] of the month ,

6.english_reference: the famine was sore in the city , so that there was no bread for the people of the land

traditions.WLC: וַ יֶּחֱזַ֥ק הָ רָעָ֖ב בָּ עִ֑יר וְ לֹא הָיָ֥ה לֶ֖חֶם לְ עַ֥ם הָ אָֽרֶץ

traditions.KJV: the famine was sore in the city , so that there was no bread for the people of the land .

7.english_reference: Then the city was broken up , and all the men of war fled

traditions.WLC: וַ תִּבָּקַ֣ע הָ עִ֗יר וְ כָל אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַ מִּלְחָמָ֡ה יִבְרְחוּ֩

traditions.KJV: which [ was ] by the king ’s garden ;

traditions.KJV: ( now the Chaldeans [ were ] by the city round about : )

7.english_reference: and they went by the way of the plain

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּלְכ֖וּ דֶּ֥רֶךְ הָ עֲרָבָֽה

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּרְדְּפ֤וּ חֵיל כַּשְׂדִּים֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ יַּשִּׂ֥יגוּ אֶת צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּ עַֽרְבֹ֣ת יְרֵח֑וֹ

traditions.KJV: where he gave judgment upon him .
